page.overview:
Who is Rodrigo?

Rodrigo was a character in The Swordsman.

Rodrigo was a draftsman in the Imperial Engineering Guild and later helped to build a colony on Amarynth III. The village was later taken over by the slave Varek, who imprisoned Rodrigo and his daughter Gina in a dungeon. One day, a stranger calling himself the Swordsman fell into the dungeon. Rodrigo and Gina helped him recover and revealed a secret exit that Rodrigo had built for the previous governor. Upon escaping, the Swordsman forged a new sword and inspired the villagers to rise in revolt against Varek. Varek and his followers were defeated, though Rodrigo was killed in the conflict.
